transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I came in because... I'm having some trouble at work. I just can't seem to keep my mind on the actual experiment anymore. 

Um... I'll be in the middle of a grant call, or a safety meeting, and I'll notice... I don't know, a pump vibration in the lab. Or a student's side comment. Or even just some odd peak in an old spectrum. And suddenly I'm just off chasing that for hours... while the thing everyone actually needs from me just sort of falls apart. 

So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do you often find yourself making careless mistakes or forgetting things at work?
No, not really. I don't think I make careless mistakes. And I don't forget what I'm supposed to be doing... I just end up focusing on something else instead.
Do you ever become so focused on something that you lose track of everything else around you?
I don't know if I'd say I lose track of everything else. I just... I get interested in the other thing. I still know where I am.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop thinking about the new thing that's caught your interest?
I wouldn't say I'm unable to stop. It's just... it's what I'm thinking about at the time. I could stop if I needed to, I suppose. I just usually don't.
Do you feel anxious when you're unable to pursue the new things that catch your interest?
Not really. I don't think I get anxious about it. If I can't do whatever it is... I just do something else. It's not really a big deal.
Do you ever have thoughts that keep repeating in your mind, even when you try to think about something else?
No, I don't think so. I don't really get stuck on things like that. If I want to think about something else... I just do.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety when you're sitting still?
No. I don't think so. I mean... if I need to sit still, I just sit. I haven't really noticed being fidgety.
Do you ever feel like you have to perform certain rituals or routines in order to feel right or to prevent something bad from happening?
No. I don't do anything like that. I just... go about my day normally, I guess. I don't have any rituals.
Do you often find yourself talking more than others in social situations?
No, not really. I mostly just... listen, I suppose. I don't talk more than anyone else.
Do you often have a lot of thoughts running through your mind at the same time?
No... I don't think so. Just the regular amount, I guess. I haven't really noticed my mind doing that.
Do you often have trouble finishing what you start?
No... I usually finish things. I mean, if it's something I need to do for work or around the house, I just do it. I don't really leave things half-done.
Do you often find yourself switching from one activity to another without completing the first one?
No... not really. I think that's sort of like what you just asked. I mostly just stick to whatever I'm doing until it's done.
Do you often dominate conversations when you're with friends or family?
No, I don't think I do. I'm usually more of a listener, honestly. I don't really talk over people or anything.
Do you often struggle to stay focused on a task for as long as it requires to be completed?

I suppose... lately, yes. That's actually why I came in. I just... I can't seem to keep my mind on the actual experiment anymore. 

I'll be on a grant call, or in a safety meeting, and... I don't know, I'll notice a pump vibration, or a student's side comment, or maybe some odd peak in an old spectrum. And suddenly I'm just... off chasing that for hours. While the thing everyone actually needs from me just falls apart.
Do you ever have intrusive thoughts that are unwanted and disturbing?
No... I don't think so. I mean, my mind wanders, like I said, but... not disturbing things. Just regular thoughts.
Are you finding that your difficulty staying focused on tasks is causing problems in your relationships with coworkers or affecting your overall job performance?

I mean... yes. It's... it's been an issue. 

My department actually had to... step in. On some things. Things I normally handle. Because I kept missing priorities, and... the scheduling got confused. They felt like my supervision was strained, and it was... putting the project at risk. And some lab safety expectations, I guess. So... yes, it's affecting my job.
Do you feel a strong need to understand or resolve the things that distract you, like the pump vibration or the odd peak in the spectrum?
I don't know if it's a strong need, exactly. It's just... I notice it, and then I'm looking at it. I don't really think about why.
Do you feel like you need to fully understand or figure out the things that distract you, like the pump vibration or the odd peak in the spectrum, before you can move on?
I think... I just answered that. I just notice things. I don't... I don't feel like I have to figure them out. I just get distracted.
Do you feel like the things that distract you are somehow important or significant, even if others might not think so?
Not really. I don't... I don't think they mean anything special. They're just things happening in the room. I just happen to look at them.
Do you feel like the distractions are related to worries or fears that you have
No. I don't think so. I'm not... afraid of the equipment or anything. I just get distracted by it.
